workflows.content:
name: Build V0.8 candidate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "releases/V0.8-candidate/build_trigger_main.txt"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: v0.8-candidate
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install validator dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --quiet beautifulsoup4
      - name: Build candidate from locked V0.7.8 body
        run: python releases/V0.8-candidate/build.py
      - name: Validate content and function contract
        run: |
          python releases/V0.8-candidate/validators/validate.py \
            published/V0.7.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html \
            published/V0.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
      - name: Verify checksum
        run: sha256sum --check releases/V0.8-candidate/SHA256SUMS.txt
      - name: Commit candidate artifact to candidate branch
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add published/V0.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Candidate artifact already current"
          else
            git commit -m "Build V0.8 CANVAS candidate HTML"
            git push origin HEAD:v0.8-candidate
          fi

name: Build V0.8 formal release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "releases/V0.8/source/from_V0.7.8.patch.json.gz.b64"
      - "releases/V0.8/build_trigger.txt"
      - "tools/apply_line_patch.py"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build locked V0.8 artifact
        run: |
          python tools/apply_line_patch.py \
            published/V0.7.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html \
            releases/V0.8/source/from_V0.7.8.patch.json.gz.b64 \
            published/V0.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
      - name: Verify release checksum
        run: echo "c02aad24689eefaed372decb3068f339a83d5c15fdf8b45f259c019418ceece2  published/V0.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html" | sha256sum --check
      - name: Commit formal artifact
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add published/V0.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "V0.8 artifact already current"
          else
            git commit -m "Publish V0.8 CANVAS formal release"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

jobs:
  build-v080:
    if: github.head_ref == 'v0.8-candidate'

          fi

name: Publish remote release asset

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "releases/**/source/remote_asset.json"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download and verify release asset
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import pathlib
          import urllib.request

          manifests = sorted(pathlib.Path("releases").glob("*/source/remote_asset.json"))
          if not manifests:
              raise SystemExit("remote asset manifest missing")
          manifest_path = manifests[-1]
          data = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text("utf-8"))
          target = pathlib.Path(data["target"])
          target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          with urllib.request.urlopen(data["url"], timeout=180) as response:
              target.write_bytes(response.read())
          digest = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          if digest != data["sha256"]:
              raise SystemExit(f"SHA256 mismatch: {digest}")
          print(f"verified {target}: {digest}")
          PY
      - name: Validate release contract
        run: |
          python releases/V0.7.8/validators/validate_figure_study.py published/V0.7.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
      - name: Commit published artifact
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add published/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Artifact already published"
          else
            git commit -m "Publish V0.7.8 CANVAS HTML"
            git push
          fi

name: Validate paper reader release

      - "releases/V0.8.2/source/patch_chunks/**"

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build V0.8.2 candidate from locked V0.8.1
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/v0.8.2-candidate' && hashFiles('releases/V0.8.2/build.py') != '' }}
        run: python releases/V0.8.2/build.py
      - name: Validate V0.8.2 candidate contract
        if: ${{ hashFiles('published/V0.8.2_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html') != '' }}
        run: >-
          python releases/V0.8.2/validators/validate.py
          published/V0.8.2_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html
          --sha256 84c37e235f40e782c79de6625ddd9369cba64095f28bff75ae702fb5893f6ff1
      - name: Validate V0.7.8 figure-study contract
        if: ${{ hashFiles('published/V0.7.8_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html') != '' }}
        run: >-
          python releases/V0.7.8/validators/validate_figure_study.py

      - name: Commit V0.8.2 candidate artifact

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add published/V0.8.2_CANVAS_Cellular_architecture_and_neighborhood-informed_virtual_spatial_tumor_profiling.html

            echo "V0.8.2 candidate artifact already current"
          else
            git commit -m "Build V0.8.2 CANVAS candidate HTML"
            git push origin HEAD:v0.8.2-candidate
          fi
